name: Miku & Teto Border
description: Adds a Miku & Teto border to every level!

sprite-mode.name: Sprite Layout Mode
sprite-mode.description: Select which character sprites appear and how they are arranged.

spacing.name: Sprite Spacing
spacing.description: Distance between sprites in pixels (lower = denser border).

sprite-size.name: Sprite Base Size
sprite-size.description: Base size of each border sprite in pixels.

show-top.name: Show Top Border
show-top.description: Display sprites along the top screen edge.

render-behind-hud.name: Render Behind HUD
render-behind-hud.description: Draw border elements behind user interface overlays.

spin-speed.name: Rotation Speed (%)
spin-speed.description: Base rotation speed of sprites when idle.

pulse-strength.name: Pulsation Amplitude (%)
pulse-strength.description: Breathing scale expansion strength when idle.

click-sync.name: Click Reaction Sync
click-sync.description: Synchronize rotation and pulsation with player inputs.

click-spin-boost.name: Click Rotation Boost (%)
click-spin-boost.description: Rotation speed multiplier while clicking or holding jump.

click-pulse-boost.name: Click Pulse Boost (%)
click-pulse-boost.description: Pulsation size boost multiplier while clicking or holding jump.
